info.title: The standard parameter words: the units, what each measures, and the scales

PARAM_SCALES.description: How a host draws a parameter: linear, logarithmic (a frequency, a time) or in discrete steps. The words omx-plugins' declarations and plugin-hostd's protocol use; a travel names its own with `scale`.

oneOf.title: linear
oneOf.description: The value is linear in position.

oneOf.title: log
oneOf.description: The value is geometric in position; both bounds are positive.

oneOf.title: stepped
oneOf.description: The whole numbers from min to max, step 1.

PARAM_UNITS.description: The one list of standard units (the owner's ruling of 2026-11-20, standard vocabulary in one place; docs/units.md): each word's `x-symbol` is its symbol as written (`%`, `""`, `dB/oct`), the word a name the wire can carry, its `x-dimension` what it measures (a word of PARAM_UNIT_DIMENSIONS) and its group its scope (a word of PARAM_UNIT_SCOPES). The schema's $defs.unit enum is the ids (consts) of the `param` units and $defs.descriptorUnit those of the `descriptor` units and `unknown`, in this order (tools/unit-enum.mjs): the id is the wire word, the `x-symbol` its display rendering only (C2, plugin-hostd#215 D1/D2). A word's code is its position in the list, not a wire number (the wire codes are omx-clap's, the unit codes of org.openmixer.param-contract/1): a reader takes the words, so a unit removed shifts the codes after it (omx-contract#167: `x` went, `coef` is the plain multiplier). A level's own spellings (an LV2 unit, a CLAP unit code) map onto these ids at that level.
PARAM_UNITS.x-why: The unit list is declared once (omx-panel docs/behaviour-core.md, decision 3): the panel core and descriptor validation read one list.

PARAM_UNIT_DIMENSIONS.description: What a unit of PARAM_UNITS measures (docs/units.md, The dimensions): two units of one dimension measure the same kind of quantity (ms and s, Hz and kHz), so a reader can tell which units a value may be shown in. oneOf.x-text: A unit only a descriptor's control states.

PARAM_UNITS_CLAP_ENCODED.description: The standard units the CLAP extension org.openmixer.param-contract/1 encodes (docs/units.md, V23d B2): the ids that have a unit code at the CLAP level, each a word of PARAM_UNITS taken from it, in its order. omx-panel reads it to know whether a unit can be served; omx-clap's map check holds its code-to-id mapping onto it. The codes are omx-clap's; this item names none.
PARAM_UNITS_CLAP_ENCODED.x-why: A reader that asks whether a unit can be served reads omx-contract only, the innermost layer, so nothing reads outward to omx-clap (coordinator ruling B2, 2026-11-22). Derived by tools/clap-encoded.mjs, never typed.

PARAM_MEANINGS.description: What a descriptor control does, its ROLE (docs/descriptors.md, "Meanings"; ruling R1 of 2026-11-24 on omx-contract#61: declare, don't infer): required on every control, a closed list, one word per meaning. Where LV2's param: vocabulary or lv2:designation has the term the word carries its name. The schema's $defs.meaning enum is these words in this order (tools/unit-enum.mjs). `unknown`: the plugin states none, and a consumer binds nothing to it.

oneOf.title: gain
oneOf.description: A gain, a level change in dB or as a factor (LV2 param:gain).

oneOf.title: threshold
oneOf.description: The level a dynamics process acts above or below (LV2 param:threshold).

oneOf.title: ratio
oneOf.description: A dynamics ratio, n:1 (LV2 param:ratio).

oneOf.title: attack
oneOf.description: How fast a process engages (LV2 param:attack).

oneOf.title: release
oneOf.description: How fast a process lets go (LV2 param:release).

oneOf.title: hold
oneOf.description: How long a process holds before it releases (LV2 param:hold).

oneOf.title: decay
oneOf.description: How fast a sound or an envelope dies away (LV2 param:decay).

oneOf.title: frequency
oneOf.description: A frequency: an EQ band's centre, an oscillator's pitch (LV2 param:frequency).

oneOf.title: cutoffFrequency
oneOf.description: A filter's cutoff frequency (LV2 param:cutoffFrequency).

oneOf.title: resonance
oneOf.description: A filter's resonance (LV2 param:resonance).

oneOf.title: bypass
oneOf.description: On when the process is bypassed (LV2 param:bypass); the inverse of enabled.
oneOf.x-text: On when the process is bypassed.

oneOf.title: wetDryRatio
oneOf.description: The mix of a wet and a dry signal (LV2 param:wetDryRatio).
oneOf.x-text: The mix of a wet and a dry signal.

oneOf.title: delay
oneOf.description: A delay time (LV2 param:delay).

oneOf.title: enabled
oneOf.description: On when the process is on (LV2 lv2:enabled); the inverse of bypass.
oneOf.x-text: On when the process is on.

oneOf.title: range
oneOf.description: How far a process may act: a gate's or an expander's range.
oneOf.x-text: A gate's or an expander's range.

oneOf.title: knee
oneOf.description: How gradually a dynamics process engages around its threshold.

oneOf.title: hysteresis
oneOf.description: The gap between a gate's opening and closing levels.

oneOf.title: makeup
oneOf.description: The gain applied after a dynamics process.

oneOf.title: lookahead
oneOf.description: How far ahead a process reads its input.

oneOf.title: ceiling
oneOf.description: The level a limiter's output never exceeds.

oneOf.title: output
oneOf.description: The output level of a process.

oneOf.title: q
oneOf.description: An EQ band's or a filter's quality factor.

oneOf.title: bandwidth
oneOf.description: An EQ band's or a filter's width, in octaves; q is its quality factor.

oneOf.title: slope
oneOf.description: How steeply a filter or a shelf rolls off.

oneOf.title: width
oneOf.description: A stereo width.

oneOf.title: drive
oneOf.description: How hard a saturation or distortion is driven.

oneOf.title: tone
oneOf.description: A tone control: a brightness or a darkness.

oneOf.title: rate
oneOf.description: The rate of a modulation, such as an LFO's speed.

oneOf.title: depth
oneOf.description: The depth of a modulation.

oneOf.title: feedback
oneOf.description: How much of a process's output feeds back into its input.

oneOf.title: spread
oneOf.description: How far voices or taps are spread apart.

oneOf.title: predelay
oneOf.description: The delay before a reverb's tail.

oneOf.title: size
oneOf.description: A reverb's room size.

oneOf.title: damping
oneOf.description: How fast a reverb's high frequencies die away.

oneOf.title: lowCut
oneOf.description: A low cut, a high-pass corner.

oneOf.title: highCut
oneOf.description: A high cut, a low-pass corner.

oneOf.title: shift
oneOf.description: A pitch or a frequency shift.

oneOf.title: fine
oneOf.description: A fine adjustment of another control.

oneOf.title: sync
oneOf.description: On when a time follows the host's tempo.
oneOf.x-text: On when a time follows the tempo.

oneOf.title: division
oneOf.description: A note division a tempo-synced time takes.

oneOf.title: listen
oneOf.description: On when the process's side signal is heard alone.
oneOf.x-text: On when the side signal is heard alone.

oneOf.title: shape
oneOf.description: A choice of waveform or curve shape.

oneOf.title: model
oneOf.description: A choice of the modelled unit.

oneOf.title: algorithm
oneOf.description: A choice of algorithm.

oneOf.title: mode
oneOf.description: A choice of mode.

oneOf.title: type
oneOf.description: A choice of type, such as a filter's.

oneOf.title: pingpong
oneOf.description: On when a delay bounces between the channels.
oneOf.x-text: On when a delay bounces between the channels.

oneOf.title: amount
oneOf.description: How strongly a process acts, from none to all of it: a balancer's pull toward its target.

oneOf.title: number
oneOf.description: How many of a repeated part a process runs: voices, delay taps, bands or stages.
oneOf.x-text: A number of voices, taps, bands or stages.

oneOf.title: balance
oneOf.description: Where a signal sits between two sides: a pan between the left and right channels, or one part's level against another's.
oneOf.x-text: A pan or a balance between two sides.

oneOf.title: link
oneOf.description: How a process ties its channels together: on when they act as one, or a choice of how they are linked.

oneOf.title: solo
oneOf.description: On when one part of a process is heard alone, the others silent; listen is the side signal heard alone.
oneOf.x-text: On when one part is heard alone.

oneOf.title: order
oneOf.description: The order a chain's stages run in.

oneOf.title: acceleration
oneOf.description: How fast a moving part changes speed: a rotor's spin-up and slow-down.

oneOf.title: dispersion
oneOf.description: How far a process spreads a sound's frequencies apart in time: a spring's chirp.

oneOf.title: window
oneOf.description: How long a stretch of signal a process reads or turns at once: a loudness window, a reverse reverb's swell.

oneOf.title: unknown
oneOf.description: The plugin states no meaning: the control has no role and is bound to nothing.

PARAM_FILTER_RESPONSES.description: The response of the filter a descriptor control sets (docs/descriptors.md, "Filter responses"; omx-contract#208): optional on a control, a closed list, one word per shape. omx-dsp's EQ design reads these words' codes for the section kinds it builds (omx_eq_kind, through this item's render), so a word's code is the integer a kernel reads for it and is never moved. A consumer finds an EQ's edges by these words (highpass, lowpass), never by a word in a control's name. The schema's $defs.filterResponse enum is these words in this order (tools/unit-enum.mjs).

oneOf.title: peaking
oneOf.description: A peaking response, a bell: a boost or a cut around a centre frequency.

oneOf.title: lowShelf
oneOf.description: A low shelf: a boost or a cut of everything below a corner frequency.

oneOf.title: highShelf
oneOf.description: A high shelf: a boost or a cut of everything above a corner frequency.

oneOf.title: highpass
oneOf.description: A high-pass: passes what is above its cutoff and cuts what is below it, an EQ's low edge.

oneOf.title: lowpass
oneOf.description: A low-pass: passes what is below its cutoff and cuts what is above it, an EQ's high edge.

oneOf.title: notch
oneOf.description: A notch: a narrow null at its centre frequency.

oneOf.title: bandpass
oneOf.description: A band-pass: passes a band around its centre frequency and cuts either side of it.

oneOf.title: allpass1
oneOf.description: A first-order all-pass: every frequency at unity gain, its phase turned around a corner frequency.

oneOf.title: allpass2
oneOf.description: A second-order all-pass: every frequency at unity gain, its phase turned around a centre frequency.
